standard_prerequisites.name: Strongly cartesian lifting
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the lifting f^*y -> y used to reduce morphisms over an arbitrary arrow to morphisms in one fibre.

core_obligations: Direction (1) => (2): evaluate the Mor sheaf on V/U and use that F is bijective on morphisms lying over a fixed arrow, in particular over identities.
Direction (2) => (1): fix a target arrow f : U -> V; choose a strongly cartesian lift f^*y -> y and identify morphisms over f with morphisms in the fibre over U via the lift.
Conclude using that F preserves strongly cartesian morphisms, so the same identification holds in S_2, and the fibre-level map is an isomorphism by (2).
proof_roadmap: Both directions reduce morphisms over an arbitrary base arrow to morphisms inside a single fibre using a strongly cartesian lift.
difficulty_reason: Two short symmetric directions, each a fibre-level reduction through a strongly cartesian lift; no construction or case analysis.
